_comment: The `nros-metadata.json` half of the declared-QoS compile fixture: one
component row, shaped exactly as `nano_ros_node_register()` writes one.
It states WHICH components the image registers, and nothing about what
they create -- that is the contract's job, and it is stated in
`declared_qos.yaml` beside this file, which is the model the header is
rendered from. This file used to carry an `"entities"` key; no production
build writes one, and the reader now refuses it (issue 1555).
